about_short_description.short_description: Legalist is an institutional alternative asset management firm. The firm uses data-driven technology to invest in credit assets at scale.

product.name: Government Receivables Strategy
product.description: Investment strategy focusing on financing secured by local, state, and federal government contracts, grants, tax credits, rebates, and receivables.

product.name: Litigation Finance
product.description: Provision of capital to plaintiffs or law firms to fund legal cases in exchange for a portion of the judgment or settlement.

product.name: Bankruptcy and Debtor-in-Possession Financing
product.description: Financing provided to companies undergoing bankruptcy to support operations during restructuring.

product.name: SVB Disaster Funding
product.description: Short-term loans and claim purchase options for companies affected by Silicon Valley Bank's failure, based on their SVB account balances.
